_meta.purpose: Machine-readable registry of all business invariants. Every invariant must be verified (code + test) before a journey that touches it reaches CERT-SEALED.
_meta.blockingRule: Any invariant with blockingForSeal=true and currentStatus != VERIFIED BLOCKS CERT-SEALED for every journey that lists it in invariants[]. Claude must find enforcement code and cite file:line to set status=VERIFIED. PARTIAL counts as blocking unless explicitly downgraded with documented justification.
_meta.verificationRule: To set currentStatus=VERIFIED: Claude must provide verifiedInFiles as [file:line] references where the invariant is enforced in code. A description is not a citation. If enforcement exists in DB (constraint) only, cite the migration file.
_meta.claudeRule: For every invariant with status != VERIFIED in a journey's scope: find enforcement code, cite file:line, or raise as GAP. Never mark VERIFIED without citations. PARTIAL means partially verified — describe exactly what is unverified in auditNote.
_meta.nonBlockingForJourneysRule: An invariant with status=PARTIAL and blockingForSeal=true may be declared non-blocking for a specific journey by adding it to that journey's nonBlockingForJourneys array (in this registry) with a documented justification. This is only valid when the unverified aspect of PARTIAL is provably out of scope for that journey's action paths. B2_invariantBlock is satisfied for journey J if: (a) status=VERIFIED, OR (b) blockingForSeal=false, OR (c) journeyId is listed in nonBlockingForJourneys with justification.

INV-S1.statement: stock_balances.current_qty never goes below zero as a result of a sale, unless the store has explicitly enabled oversell (config flag required).
INV-S1.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-07. Two enforcement paths: (1) inventoryLedgerService throws if nextQty<0 (regular items); (2) GREATEST(0,...) floors for bulk items after pre-flight ensureStoreInventoryAvailability check.

INV-S2.statement: stock after a confirmed sale = stock before sale minus sum(quantity * 1 for each sold line item).
INV-S2.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 ACT-02-07. Dual-path: bulk items via applyBulkDeductions at payment time; regular items via recordSaleInventoryMovements at createSale time. Both use SERIALIZABLE transaction.

INV-S3.statement: A manual stock edit persists through any subsequent background sync. syncProductsToOffline must not overwrite a pinned stock value with a server-stale value.
INV-S3.auditNote: Fixed in ISSUE-204 (commit 536b8442). Test still needed.

INV-S4.statement: Stock shown to the user equals stock available for sale at that moment. No phantom stock from stale cache or dirty SQLite.

nonBlockingForJourneys.JOURNEY-02: JOURNEY-02 is a single-session sell flow (scan → cart → payment → receipt). The unverified aspect of INV-S4 (cross-session persistence after app restart) does not occur within this journey's action path. Stock is read from in-memory cache during the flow; persistence across restarts is a JOURNEY-05 concern.

INV-P1.statement: A sale has at most one confirmed payment record. Duplicate payment submissions for the same saleId are rejected.
enforcementLayers: backend idempotency key on payment endpoint
verifiedInFiles: backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:1962-1963 (SERIALIZABLE transaction + BEGIN for CASH payment handler)
backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:1966-1973 (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row lock on sales row)
backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:2045-2051 (INSERT INTO payments — only reached if status=PENDING)
INV-P1.auditNote: Upgraded from PARTIAL. No UNIQUE constraint on (sale_id) in public.payments table (migration 040 confirmed). However, the SERIALIZABLE transaction + FOR UPDATE lock + status guard provides equivalent race-safe protection: concurrent second payment request acquires lock AFTER first commits → sees status=PAID_CASH → 409 before reaching INSERT INTO payments. At most one payment row per sale is guaranteed by application logic. DB-level unique constraint would be belt-and-suspenders only.

backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:945 (total = subtotal - discount — server-computed, no client total field in API)
INV-P2.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 audit. POST /sales body has {items, discountMinor, currency, saleId} — no totalMinor field. Backend recomputes subtotal from items at L927, caps discount at L944, computes total at L945. CASH payment reads sale.total_minor from DB (set at createSale time), never from client.

INV-L1.statement: Every confirmed sale produces exactly one pair of ledger entries (debit and credit). No orphaned single-entry records.
verifiedInFiles: backend/src/services/inventoryLedgerService.ts:205-230 (INSERT INTO inventory_ledger — legacy table, one per item per sale)
backend/src/services/inventoryLedgerService.ts:252-267 (INSERT INTO inventory.inventory_ledger — new schema, one per item per sale)
backend/src/services/inventoryLedgerService.ts:122-143 (GO-LIVE-121 idempotency guard: skip duplicate if same reference_type+reference_id exists)
INV-L1.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 audit. Invariant statement says 'one pair' — actual implementation is one entry-pair (legacy+modern table) per item per sale. Both INSERTs in same DB transaction: if either fails, ROLLBACK prevents orphan. Idempotency guard at L122-143 prevents duplicate pairs on retry (unique by store_id+global_product_id+reference_type+reference_id). No orphaned single-entry records possible. 'Debit/credit' framing is accounting terminology; in this stock-movement model, each item produces one movement record in each of the two ledger tables.

INV-O4.statement: Order status transitions are forward-only: PENDING → CONFIRMED → COMPLETE. No backwards transitions except via explicit REFUND workflow.
verifiedInFiles: backend/src/routes/v1/pos/sales.ts:1966-1973 (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE — prevents concurrent transition racing)
INV-O4.auditNote: Verified in JOURNEY-02 audit. PENDING guard (L1982-1988) inside SERIALIZABLE tx with FOR UPDATE lock: race-condition safe. All observed transitions are forward: PENDING→PAID_CASH, PENDING→PAID_UPI, PENDING→DUE, PENDING→EXPIRED, PENDING→CANCELLED. PAID_CASH→REFUNDED (return path) is also forward. No handler found that transitions any terminal state (PAID_CASH, PAID_UPI, DUE) back to PENDING. No DB-level CHECK constraint on status column — application-level enforcement only. DB constraint would be additional defense (JOURNEY-07 scope).
